text:
matt: afternoon check-in — quick GPU capacity pulse before EOD. yesterday: landed AZ spillover fix for us-west-2. block: waiting on quota bump in europe-west1 for A100s. today: follow up w/ cloud team, review CR from @sasha
sasha: looking at the CR now, small nits on backoff logic. will approve once tests pass. also flagged a potential race when draining nodes :thinking_face:
olivia: infra-bot posted utilization earlier — overall fleet 82% used, but eu region at 97% for A100s. opened ticket with cloud support (TKT-4567) for quota increase. I can ping PM for prioritization
leo: did a small deploy to dedicated-provisioner to change burst size from 6->8 for short jobs. observed 10% lower tail latency in staging. will monitor in prod after @anika gives 👍
anika: can give the go once we confirm the canary doesn't push eu over hard cap. also, reminder: quota increases can take 24-72h depending on provider — we should have safe fallback routing to p3/p4 if A100s are unavailable
infra-bot: daily-fleet-summary: total_gpus=1248, in_use=1026 (82%), eu-a100_in_use=286/296 (97%), pending_q_inc=TKT-4567, last_scaled=2026-06-12T15:03Z
matt: re: fallback routing — @sasha can you add a policy to route new requests to dedicated-pool-spot if eu A100s >= 95%? keep on same model variant but different instance type
sasha: yep, will add policy and a canary rule (10% traffic) in routing-config. pushing branch now, ping @matt for CR
olivia: cloud support replied, asking for justification and expected usage. I drafted a short doc (link) with monthly forecast and E2E latency numbers — will share in the ticket
leo: small heads-up: a customer reported degraded perf in ap-northeast-1 yesterday — looks like node preemption spikes. I raised autoscaler min nodes by 2 as mitigation
anika: thanks @leo — please add an incident note in the runbook under "preemption mitigation" so oncall knows to do same if we see similar spikes :memo:
matt: blockers recap: waiting on cloud quota increase in eu (TKT-4567) and CR approval from @sasha. otherwise green. any other blockers?
leo: none from me, will watch ap-northeast-1 metrics overnight
sasha: CR out, tests failing on one flaky unit test — debugging now, should be quick
olivia: I'll follow up w/ cloud support to expedite justification, also looping in @maria from sales for enterprise usage numbers
anika: FYI scheduling a brief sync tomorrow 10:30am to review capacity plan for Q3 — invite coming. thanks all :thumbsup:
